scope: Normative proposal for future implementation; no runtime packet format or historical serializer change.

domains.requirement: Validated nominal-controller/model operating envelope with state, parameter, actuator and timing uncertainty.
Accepted available packet with monotonic actual timestamps, independent validation and currently eligible authority; not a physical safety certificate.
Reachable states admit a separately validated recovery policy with constraints throughout and a defined terminal safe region or feasible transfer.
A separately validated joint lateral/longitudinal policy reduces speed within available grip/actuation and corridor until a verified destination/stop transfer.
A validated policy reaches and maintains confirmed rest within available swept free space, including delays, low-speed transition and fault-dependent actuation.

fields.name: interface_version
fields.meaning: Candidate apex-safety-authority/0.1.0; future negotiated implementation revision

fields.name: session_id
fields.meaning: Unique boot/arming session shared with enforcement endpoint

fields.name: command_id
fields.meaning: Immutable request identity

fields.name: sequence
fields.meaning: Strictly increasing per session/producer; duplicates may be acknowledged idempotently but never reapplied

fields.name: source_controller_id
fields.meaning: Original generating controller or verified recovery/stop policy

fields.name: source_packet_id
fields.meaning: Original packet identity; null only for a named non-packet policy
fields.missing_policy: Null reason required for non-packet policy; not inferred

fields.name: source_manifest_sha256
fields.meaning: Exact controller/model/configuration identity

fields.name: generated_at
fields.meaning: Original computation/request generation in identified clock domain

fields.name: clock_domain
fields.meaning: Monotonic source clock with mapping to authoritative physical/control time

fields.name: clock_mapping_and_error
fields.meaning: Mapping revision, offset/drift/error bounds, synchronization health

fields.name: state_estimate
fields.meaning: Canonical [vx,vy,r,e_psi,s_abs,e_y], capture/receive timestamps, frame/map IDs and uncertainty set identity/bounds
fields.missing_policy: Required for state-dependent policy; unknown triggers eligibility failure

fields.name: packet_interval
fields.meaning: Original packet first/last actual timestamps; [start,expiry) for proposed authority; null for non-packet policy
fields.missing_policy: Packet source requires interval; timestamp list/digest must be retrievable

fields.name: generation_epoch
fields.meaning: Authority epoch when original request was generated

fields.name: permission_epoch
fields.meaning: Current supervisor epoch authorizing this application; differs only through explicit reauthorization

fields.name: permission_id
fields.meaning: Supervisor grant bound to request, epoch, scope, validated domain and evidence revision

fields.name: permission_interval
fields.meaning: Valid start and exclusive end; includes allowable held-input interval
fields.missing_policy: Required; bound conservatively including clock uncertainty

fields.name: requested_application_time
fields.meaning: Requested physical application; scheduling intention, not acknowledgement

fields.name: latest_application_time
fields.meaning: Deadline after which this request cannot be applied

fields.name: requested_control
fields.meaning: [delta,a_cmd]; a_cmd=Fx_total/m for dynamic model; device adapter requires validated allocation/calibration

fields.name: held_until_limit
fields.meaning: End of validated held-input permission; never an indefinite implicit hold
fields.missing_policy: Required; bounded by domain/authority and independent enforcement capacity

fields.name: validation_context
fields.meaning: Domain/policy revision, estimator and actuator health, uncertainty/delay bounds, checks and validity reasons
fields.missing_policy: Required; unknown mandatory check denies permission

fields.name: transition_id
fields.meaning: Mode/authority change linking revocation and any explicit reauthorization
fields.missing_policy: Null only if no transition applies

fields.name: cancellation
fields.meaning: Request, affected IDs, endpoint receipt/commit/ack times and outcome; cancellation is not instantaneous
fields.missing_policy: Unknown outcome remains pending/unknown; no fabricated ack

fields.name: application_record
fields.meaning: Endpoint receipt/decision/application times, actual applied control, previous control/time, current epoch, reason and actuator feedback provenance
fields.missing_policy: Null until observed; requested or commanded value is not measured actuator position

fields.name: lifecycle
fields.meaning: generated / queued / permitted / rejected / cancelled / applied / held / expired / superseded / unknown
fields.missing_policy: Required; transitions logged with causal identity, never interpolated

rules.title: Three gates
rules.requirement: Separate proposal feasibility, accepted trajectory authority and physical application permission; none implies the next.

rules.title: Temporal authority
rules.requirement: Use actual timestamp intervals, monotonic clock mapping/error and independent expiry. Reject unknown/nonfinite/nonmonotonic values. No N*dt inference; no extrapolation. Required ordering: capture <= generation <= requested application; requested <= actual <= latest application < permission end, with actual application >= permission start and held-until <= permission end. For packet-derived work permission end <= original packet expiry, even after reauthorization. Account conservatively for all clock uncertainty. Acknowledgement observation may occur later and is recorded separately.

rules.title: Application validation
rules.requirement: Immediately before actuator commit validate current epoch, freshness, domain/uncertainty, actual prior application, limits and permitted hold interval. Include motion during all delay; clipping cannot substitute for domain validation.

rules.title: Held command
rules.requirement: Monitor/revalidate held permission and health independently of arrival of a new command; before expiry invoke an eligible response. No valid response means NO_VALID_POLICY, not an invented safe hold.

rules.title: Ordering and revocation
rules.requirement: At the arbiter, known emergency/revocation and expiry precede grant and physical commit. Linearize epoch changes with commit; late cancellation cannot undo an application. This is a future endpoint requirement, not an edit of frozen simulator chronology.

rules.title: Old command provenance
rules.requirement: A source packet handoff does not rewrite or erase old command history. Pending old-source requests need an explicit current grant after revalidation; no implicit renewal at mode change; cancellation outcome requires acknowledgement.

rules.title: Fixed and variable handoffs
rules.requirement: Fixed readiness at deadline precedes eligibility/acceptance; late fixed result remains ineligible. Variable readiness still requires acceptance. Maintain one active owner; no interpolated IDs or activation from solver status.

rules.title: Invalid request response
rules.requirement: Reject stale, expired, replayed, unauthorized or invalid requests with reason; supersede only under validated higher/current authority. Rejection alone does not stop motion: resolve held input through a verified recovery/stop policy or NO_VALID_POLICY.

rules.title: Watchdog and communication
rules.requirement: Endpoint expires permissions independently of host progress. Missing acknowledgement means unknown application, not absent input. Independent watchdog response and timing require hardware validation.

rules.title: No-policy emergency
rules.requirement: Revoke unsupported software permissions and request the characterized physical emergency response if available. Do not command universal zero, maximum brake or power removal. If no response is validated, report uncontrolled hazard; synthetic termination preserves evidence, not a stop claim.

rules.title: Continuity and physical validity
rules.requirement: Validate actual rate since previous application and joint actuator/model constraints; accepted packet continuity is separate from reachable-set safety. Sampling validity is not continuous swept-footprint certification.

rules.title: Telemetry and information boundary
rules.requirement: Retain source/request/decision/application/ack/expiry times, queue, held value, state capture and uncertainty, domain results, fault causes and transitions. Unknown/censored values are null with reasons. Forecasts use only information available at their decision time.
